path.description: A JSON Pointer path to a value in the state

SlotNode.description: Slot binding: Reference to a specific child node.

oneOf.description: Raw text content to render directly (e.g., 'No data').
Structural node reference rendered as the description (custom ReactNode).
State path resolving to a string used as the description text.

description.description: Customized description of the empty state. ReactNode in antd; here a raw string, a structural node reference, or a state path that resolves to a string.

oneOf.description: Image URL or a preset identifier (antd Empty.PRESENTED_IMAGE_DEFAULT / Empty.PRESENTED_IMAGE_SIMPLE).
Structural node reference rendered as the image (custom ReactNode, e.g. a custom SVG/icon element).
State path resolving to a string used as the image URL or preset identifier.

image.description: Customized image of the empty state. ReactNode in antd; here an image URL/preset string, a structural node reference, or a state path that resolves to a string.

className.description: Tailwind CSS classes for the component.
